title: Effective Implementation of Age Verification and Restriction Features for Phone Apps
what_it_is: Effective Implementation of Age Verification and Restriction Features for Phone Apps

sections.label: App store age verification measures
sections.summary: The Ministry plans age assurance measures for designated app stores, including optional facial estimation technology, to prevent young users accessing age-inappropriate apps.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Digital Development and Information (a) how does the Ministry plan to ensure the effective implementation of age verification and restriction measures by app stores so that only age-appropriate apps are accessible to children given that children may download apps through their parents' user accounts; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider mandating more robust age verification methods such as facial recognition technology, to prevent children from bypassing age restrictions using their parents' passwords or biometric data.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: It aims to reduce the risk of exposure to harmful content for users, especially young users, on apps.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: To achieve its objective, the Code requires designated app stores to put in place age assurance measures to prevent young users from accessing age-inappropriate apps.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Age estimation through the use of facial estimation technology is one of the measures which designated app stores can choose to implement to meet the requirements.

sections.label: Under-18 age assurance expectations
sections.summary: App stores are minimally expected to identify users under 18 and block their highest age-rated apps, though regulations alone cannot stop adults helping children circumvent measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: For a start, they are minimally expected to be able to ascertain users under 18 and prevent them from accessing their highest age-rated apps, for example, 18+.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Regulations alone are unlikely to prevent a parent or any adult from helping a child circumvent the age assurance measures.

sections.label: Parenting resources and industry collaboration
sections.summary: The Parenting for Wellness initiative and IMDA's Digital for Life portal offer parents resources, while the Ministry continues working with industry on age assurance requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: As an example, the Ministry of Education, Ministry of Social and Family Development and Health Promotion Board launched the Parenting for Wellness initiative in September 2024, which covers resources on various topics such as managing screen use and addressing cyberbullying.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Parents can also visit the IMDA’s Digital for Life portal for bite-sized strategies on safe and responsible use of digital technologies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: We will continue to work closely with the industry on the age assurance requirements and implementation as part of our ongoing efforts to enhance online safety in Singapore.
